"Motivation overhyped. Attitude sab kuch."
"Success final nahi, failure fatal nahi."
"Mind muscle jaisa hai."
Urja se bhare raho.
Success wahi hai jo galti se seekhe.
Wo badlav bano jo tum duniya mein dekhna chahte ho.
"Persistence ka habit."
Jo tum chahte ho, woh darr ke uss paar hai.
Apne darr se mat dabo.
"Jeet ho ya na ho—quit mat karo."
"Setback ko comeback banao."
Jo bhi karo, puri taqat se karo.
Disappointment kabhi-kabhi better direction ka signpost hota.
"Consistency success ki key hai."
